title: I can tell the truth
text: I can tell the truth about this day. I can name the mercy I received. I can bring the hurt I still carry. God’s faithfulness is worthy of my thanks even when my understanding is incomplete. I will honor the help that came through other people. I will receive care without shame and offer kindness within my limits. I entrust this evening to the Lord, carrying gratitude and honest need into the same prayer.
